title: Creamy 15-Minute Pasta
intro: Garlic, tomato paste and cream turn into a soft pink sauce in minutes. Ready in 15 minutes.

items: ½–1 cup cream (depends how rich you want it)
Oregano, chilli flakes and any extra flavours you like

method: Boil the pasta till just done. Save ½ cup of the pasta water.
Warm a little olive oil, add the garlic and cook till fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for a minute.
Pour in the cream and stir till it turns a soft pink.
Add oregano, chilli flakes and the pasta water, and stir till smooth.
Add the parmesan and basil and let the sauce come together.
Toss in the pasta till every ribbon is coated.
Finish with more parmesan and basil.
